NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is regenerated by ./gradlew generatePatchesList on every release. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Allow Developer options
patches.description: Lets short movies play while Developer options are turned on, instead of asking to turn them off.

patches.name: Block tracking
patches.description: Adds an option (off by default) to stop sending most LinkedIn analytics events.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Adjust and TikTok from tracking installs and in-app events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sessions, which get every action you take in the app.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops the analytics and crash reporting SDKs (AppsFlyer, CleverTap, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Google Tag Manager, comScore and Facebook events) from collecting data. Push notifications stay.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer, Mixpanel and Insider from tracking installs, reads and other in-app events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking installs and in-app events, and turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sessions. Tuya's own usage statistics are left on.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, and the Facebook SDK with its app events.

patches.name: Disable data collection SDKs
patches.description: Stops the location, Wi-Fi and network data SDKs (Weplan, Wavebrook and its partners, Speedchecker, LowLagLabs, GeoTruth) through the app's own off switches.

patches.name: Disable double-tap like
patches.description: Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds a download button to the full screen photo and video viewer.

patches.name: Faster startup
patches.description: Stops the splash screen from waiting up to 5 seconds on the Firebase Remote Config fetch. The fetch still finishes in the background.

patches.name: Feed filters
patches.description: Adds optional filters (off by default, turned on in Fakh Patches): focus mode, celebrations, job cards, network activity (likes, comments, reposts), video posts, "Recommended for you", puzzle games, the "New posts" pill and "Show translation".

patches.name: Fix song playback
patches.description: Lets songs play on the patched app. A patched app is signed with a different key, which the server rejects when it hands out the encrypted song, so without this every song would hang on "loading".

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Sign in with Google" work, so your collection and playlists saved to your Google account come back. Signs in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so it needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Login dengan Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Continue with Google" work in patched LinkedIn by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Sign in with Google" work. Signs in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so it needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches.name: Hide AI ask bar
patches.description: Removes the "How can I help?" Tuya AI bar above the bottom navigation.

patches.name: Hide App Mall
patches.description: Removes the "App Mall" row from the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide Create button
patches.description: Removes the "+" button (write news, start a live stream) from the middle of the bottom navigation. The switch for it is on the Fakh Patches page.

patches.name: Hide Explore tab
patches.description: Removes the Explore tab from the bottom navigation.

patches.name: Hide Mall tab
patches.description: Removes the Mall tab from the bottom navigation.

patches.name: Hide Me banner
patches.description: Removes the promo banner ("Enjoy Your Smart Life") and the ad slot from the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide My Orders
patches.description: Removes the "My Orders" row from the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide Plus button
patches.description: Removes the "Plus" pill from the home header.

patches.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches.description: Removes Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, including on profiles and the profile menu.

patches.name: Hide Recommended for you
patches.description: Removes the "Recommended for You" section and its cards (AI Notes and the rest) from the home screen.

patches.name: Hide Rewards Hub
patches.description: Removes the "Rewards Hub" row and its banner from the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide Tuya AI Web Version
patches.description: Removes the "Tuya AI Web Version" row from the Me tab.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the Google ad banners from the home, article, quiz, event and live screens, and the promo popups.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the ad banners with their "Iklan" block from the home feed, articles and lists, the native ad in the feed, the Teads video ad in articles and the full-screen ad.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes promoted (sponsored) posts from the feed.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes the Google ad banners and ad rows the app shows, such as the one above the Me menu.

patches.name: Hide home tabs
patches.description: Adds switches to hide the Nonton, IDN Live, Berita and Quiz tabs, on a Fakh Patches page in the app's Settings.

patches.name: Hide package banner
patches.description: Removes the "Beli Paket" banner from the profile, since packages cannot be bought in a patched app. The switch for it is on the Fakh Patches page.

patches.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches.description: Removes promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and job search.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes "Suggested" posts from outside your network from the feed.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+): the accent color instead of GitHub blue and tinted surfaces in light and dark mode. Adds a Fakh Patches section to Settings with a Material You switch and an AMOLED black switch for a pure black dark mode.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+): the accent color instead of LinkedIn blue and the green of selected filters, and Material 3 surface colors for backgrounds, cards, bars and borders. Some screens drawn by LinkedIn's servers may keep their own colors.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Uses your wallpaper's colors (Android 12+) for the accent and the surfaces, in light and dark mode. Rounder corners and wider spacing between items.

patches.name: Messaging
patches.description: Hides sponsored messages, and adds an optional ghost mode that does not send typing indicators or read status.

patches.name: More tab
patches.description: Lets you hide items of the More tab (Puzzle games, Groups, Events, Newsletters), or move them to the bottom of the profile menu and remove the tab.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Opens external links without LinkedIn's safety/go warning page.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium on your phone (no ads, every premium feature), stops the Play license check from closing the app, and keeps the ad SDK from starting so it cannot load ads or track in the background.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks the lifetime premium client-side (no visual ads, music equalizer) and keeps the ad networks and AppHarbr from starting at all, so they cannot track in the background.

patches.name: Redirect Gold purchase
patches.description: Opens connect.idn.media/my-account/gold in the browser instead of the in-app Gold top up.

patches.name: Remove gaps and dividers
patches.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and lists are one flat surface.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from LinkedIn links when they are copied or shared.

patches.name: Song info in media notification
patches.description: Shows the song title and its album art in the media notification and the system media player, instead of the station name with no picture.

patches.name: Stop autoplay
patches.description: Adds a switch to stop the video previews and the automatic sliding of the home banners, on a Fakh Patches page in the app's Settings.

patches.name: Stop autoplay
patches.description: Stops the videos in the "Video Pilihan" block under an article from playing on their own. They play when tapped.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Windy Pro on your phone: deeper map zoom, 1-hour forecast steps, the premium calendar view and the rest of the premium screens, and hides the "Go Premium" button. Stays unlocked when you are logged out.
